thumbnail_text_variants.strategy: Text is FIXED on both arms — the image is the variable. 16 chars / 3 words, verb+time construction (the 'PAUSE HERE' 7.45% form). Morning lane: outcome register, never Q-hook (0/5 in tests). Dedup: 0 hits vs 105 used texts ('NO RUSH' and 'SLOW MORNINGS' are used — avoided). Alternate if mood reads too assertive at render time: 'EASE INTO IT' (also FRESH).

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature on aged cream parchment, ornate gold and deep-teal border. Show the VIEWER living their quiet morning, NOT a musician performing — NO instrument anywhere in frame. TWO IMAGE ARMS, identical style, palette, figure and text; ONLY the moment changes. ARM A (bed): a person waking and stretching in bed, soft dawn light through a window — the composition measured at 6.11% CTR. ARM B (window): the same person standing at the window with a cup of tea, same dawn light, same unhurried energy. Overlay 'TAKE THE MORNING' in large dark-teal serif in its own banner panel at ~35% of frame, second tier reading 'Sarangi · Raga Bilawal'. Mobile-first: text must scan at 120px.

description:
Quiet Morning | Sarangi Raga Bilawal | 1.5 Hours of calm Indian instrumental music to start the day slowly

The first hour of the day decides its pace. Before the phone, before the rush — a quiet morning is something you can choose.

This peaceful Indian ambient music holds a soft, unhurried brightness for 90 minutes, so your morning can open gently instead of starting with noise.

You'll hear the sarangi — a bowed instrument that sounds closer to a human voice than anything else in Indian music — carrying warm, sustained phrases over a soft tanpura drone. No percussion, no jumps, nothing sudden.

Perfect for slow mornings, coffee or chai in silence, journaling, morning reading, gentle stretching, easing into work, or simply keeping the house calm while the day begins.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sarangi
Raga: Bilawal — the classic bright morning raga
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Quiet, warm, unhurried
Duration: 1.5 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on when you wake and let it run through your whole morning routine. Works on a speaker filling the room or on headphones — keep it just under conversation volume.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00:00 — First light
0:08:00 — The house still quiet
0:15:00 — Warming up
0:23:00 — Chai steam
0:30:00 — Settling into the day
0:38:00 — Unhurried
0:45:00 — Soft focus
0:53:00 — Mid-morning calm
1:00:00 — Steady brightness
1:08:00 — Gentle momentum
1:15:00 — The day, slowly
1:23:00 — Carrying the calm forward

⏱ BEST FOR
Slow mornings
Coffee or chai in silence
Journaling and morning pages
Morning reading
Gentle stretching
Easing into work
Calm start before a busy day
Keeping the room peaceful

If this music helped, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian ambient healing music.
